scope: Policy-aware private connector plus HTTP/CONNECT tools proxy library. Actual TCP sockets and synthetic local peers in a Debian ARM64 Docker build with network=none; no production tools service or guest integration yet.

previous_attempt.error: Rust E0432: hyper::uri is not exported; corrected to hyper::http::uri. No gateway tests ran in that attempt. The remaining run was superseded by the fixed commit.

limits: No complete tools path through the actual session VM, gateway supervisor and firewall has been tested.
The HTTP proxy is a library component; its service executable and supervisor activation are not yet implemented.
CONNECT is opaque: these tests do not demonstrate TLS validation by Bun or application-origin/content restrictions inside an allowed tunnel.
The tools HTTP tests use a synthetic connector; connector policy tests separately use a synthetic external SOCKS peer. An integrated tools chain remains required.
Tor-specific tools circuit isolation, external proxy DNS behavior and real-provider compatibility are not proven.
Saved policies, trusted user approvals, permission expiry and per-permission tunnel revocation remain to be implemented; ask currently fails closed.
The two ignored adapter cases and eight private-process activation tests are scheduled in a swap-free VM; not counted as passing until that job completes.
All tests use synthetic data. No local Mac gateway build was attempted because of insufficient disk space.
